claims.head: The Sabres lock it down; the Maple Leafs don’t
claims.body: On shot suppression, Buffalo is near the top of the league and Toronto is one of the league’s worst. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Sabres and the Maple Leafs sit at opposite ends for shot suppression.

claims.head: The Maple Leafs’ power play outclasses the Sabres’
claims.body: The Maple Leafs are near the top of the league for the power play, at the lethal end; the Sabres are one of the league’s worst, at the harmless end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Maple Leafs and the Sabres sit at opposite ends for power play.
claims.call: The Maple Leafs’ power play creates more per 60 than the Sabres’.

TOR.head: A steep climb for Toronto
TOR.body: Buffalo has controlled the play far better over recent games, Toronto will be without Tavares, and Toronto has home ice. Toronto’s best hope is pouncing on loose pucks, plus a big night in goal.

BUF.head: This one sets up well for Buffalo
BUF.body: Buffalo has controlled the play far better over recent games, Toronto will be without Tavares, and Toronto has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Toronto can make a game of it if they pounce on loose pucks.
